title: Promise.all vs Promise.allSettled
caption:
A classic interview question: what happens to Promise.all when one promise rejects?

Interview prep for web developers on devShark: devshark.app

#javascript #interviewprep #webdevelopment #async #devshark

slides.headline: Fails fast.
slides.body: It rejects as soon as one promise rejects. You get that error, [[not the other results]].

slides.headline: Waits for all.
slides.body: Each result says [[fulfilled]] with a value or [[rejected]] with a reason.

slides.headline: all: every result is required.
slides.body: allSettled: you want every outcome, failures included.
